name: Eventsforce
description_en:
Eventsforce is a web-based event-management platform with registration, event websites, communications, programme management and reporting. Its wider product range includes awards, abstract review, mobile experiences and onsite badging. Those products solve related tasks but should not all be assumed part of a base registration purchase.

The buying guide starts with the required solutions and then scopes an annual or multi-year package around usage. This profile focuses on the organizer’s workflow and the commercial boundaries between the platform, specialist processes and event-day services.
description_zh:
Eventsforce 是网页活动管理平台，提供报名、活动网站、沟通、议程管理和报表。更广产品包括奖项、摘要评审、移动体验及现场徽章，它们解决相关需求，但不能假定全部包含在基础报名采购中。

购买指南先选择所需方案，再按使用量定义年度或多年组合。本文聚焦主办方流程，以及平台、专业程序和活动日服务的商业边界。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure forms, tickets, payments, access groups and session capacity.
core_features.explanation_zh: 配置表单、票据、支付、访问组与场次容量。

core_features.explanation_en: Separate solutions manage submissions, review/scoring and decisions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 独立方案管理提交、评审/评分和决定。

en: Coordinate member registration, abstract decisions and session access.
zh: 协调会员报名、摘要决定和场次访问。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Specify registration/review modules and usage, then test one eligible, one waitlisted and one cancelled attendee.
steps.zh: 明确报名/评审模块与用量，再测试合格、候补及取消参与者。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Custom annual/multi-year package by platform usage and add-ons.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Annual or fixed multi-year package quoted against registrations/awards usage and selected solutions/add-ons. No standard public amount or free production entitlement verified; training, support, payment and onsite equipment scope require confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 按报名/奖项使用量和所选方案/附加项询问年度或固定多年组合，未核实标准金额或免费生产权益，培训、支持、支付和现场设备范围需确认。

sources.title: Event Management Software Solutions - Manage Events Efficiently - Eventsforce
sources.research_notes_en: Web-based event platform with separately named Awards, Abstracts, Mobile, Virtual/Hybrid and onsite solutions.

sources.title: Event Management Product Packages - Best Value for Your Business - Eventsforce
sources.research_notes_en: Official buying guide quotes annual or fixed multi-year packages based on registrations/awards and selected add-ons; no amount.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Define eligibility and the session path
sections.en: The platform lists registration, bespoke sites, invitations, an agenda/form builder, payments, access groups, attendance and waiting lists. For an illustrative member conference, distinguish member eligibility from ticket payment and session attendance. Test a changed registration, a full session and a cancellation before opening sales; a confirmation email alone does not establish valid session access or payment settlement.
sections.zh: 平台列有报名、定制网站、邀请、议程/表单编辑、支付、访问组、出席及候补。例如会员会议，应区分会员资格、付款和场次到场，售票前测试报名修改、满额和取消。确认邮件不能单独证明场次资格有效或收款已结算。

sections.title_en: Keep judging and conference review within the right solution
sections.title_zh: 把评奖和会议评审放在正确方案
sections.en: Awards handles entry forms, judging, payments, communications and table bookings. Abstracts handles submission topics, parameters, reviewers and an online agenda. Mobile, hybrid, virtual and badging are separately listed options. Confirm the required handoff from an accepted abstract or award result to registration and event-day records rather than assuming every module automatically shares every field.
sections.zh: Awards 处理参评、评审、支付、沟通和桌位；Abstracts 处理主题、投稿参数、评审及在线议程。移动、混合、线上和徽章另列。应确认录用稿件或评奖结果如何进入报名和现场记录，不能假设所有模块自动共享所有字段。

sections.title_zh: 合并核对用量与服务报价
sections.en: The buying guide offers annual or fixed-cost multi-year packages, with price based on platform usage such as registrations or awards and additions such as badging. No public amount or sustained-free plan was verified. Ask for usage counting, included solutions, API/SSO, payment charges, training, onsite equipment and support. Vendor response-time averages are marketing descriptions, not an agreed incident SLA.
sections.zh: 购买指南提供年度或固定费用多年方案，价格按报名、奖项等使用量和徽章等附加项确定。未核实公开金额或持续免费计划。需询问计量、方案、API/SSO、支付费用、培训、现场设备及支持。厂商平均响应时间不是已约定事故 SLA。

sections.title_en: Validate recovery and data exit before event day
sections.title_zh: 活动日前确认恢复与数据退出
sections.en: Eventsforce merits investigation for an event programme with multiple registration, review or engagement needs. A minimal RSVP may not justify the implementation. Verify the exact export, integration mappings, offline check-in and recovery plan with representative records. No deployment, export, review, payment or onsite test was performed. Self-hosting, source license and contractual storage/retention were not established.
sections.zh: 具有报名、评审或互动多需求的活动计划可研究 Eventsforce，简易 RSVP 未必需要实施。应使用代表性记录核对导出、映射、离线签到和恢复。本文未执行部署、导出、评审、支付或现场测试，自托管、源码许可及合同存储/保留未确定。

research_gaps: No registration, review, payment, mobile app, onsite badge, integration or export was tested.
Usage counting, quote amounts, add-ons, API/SSO, offline/recovery, DPA, source license and self-hosting require confirmation.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
